title: The Lord's Servant

questions.question: Behold my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul what?
I have put my Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:1 (ESV): "he will bring forth justice to the nations."

questions.question: He will not cry aloud or lift up his voice, or make it heard in the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:2 (ESV): "or make it heard in the street;"

questions.question: A bruised reed he will not break, and a faintly burning wick he will not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:3 (ESV): "and a faintly burning wick he will not quench;"

questions.question: I am the LORD; that is my name; my glory I give to no other, nor my praise to what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:8 (ESV): "nor my praise to carved idols."

questions.question: He will not grow faint or be discouraged till he has established justice in the earth; and the coastlands wait for his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:4 (ESV): "and the coastlands wait for his law."

questions.question: I have given you as a covenant for the people, a light for the nations, to open the eyes that are what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:6-7 (ESV): "to open the eyes that are blind,"

questions.question: Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise from the end of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:10 (ESV): "his praise from the end of the earth,"

questions.question: Let the desert and its cities lift up their voice, the villages that who inhabits?
The LORD goes out like a mighty man, like a man of war he stirs up his what?
I have kept still and restrained myself; now I will cry out like a woman in what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:14 (ESV): "I will cry out like a woman in labor;"

questions.question: I will lead the blind in a way that they do not know, in paths that they have not known I will do what to them?
Hear, you deaf, and look, you blind, that you may see! Who is blind but my servant, or deaf as my whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:19 (ESV): "or deaf as my messenger whom I send?"

questions.question: The LORD was pleased, for his righteousness' sake, to magnify his law and make it what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 42:21 (ESV): "to magnify his law and make it glorious."

questions.question: Who gave up Jacob to the looter, and Israel to the plunderers? Was it not the whom?

key_verse_text: Behold my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights; I have put my Spirit upon him; he will bring forth justice to the nations.
